newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end firmer after dull day.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end firmer after dull day.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended a few ticks higher in meager turnover on Monday ahead of Canada Day public and market holiday. * Very light trading of 44 million shares worth C$723 million.
Toronto's key stock index finished firmer in extremely thin trade on Monday, unfazed by weaker bonds while a skeleton crew of players staffed desks ahead of Tuesday's public and market holiday.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index added 11.34 points to reach 6437.74.
The nation celebrates Canada Day on Tuesday.
"We're holding onto very modest gains while bonds and bills sold off today," said MMS International analyst Katherine Beattie. "But you can't read too much into it because volumes are low."
